senses.gloss: m. (ζῶσμα = ζῶμα, in the sense of περίζωμα) cook’s apron.
units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 4">Num. R. s. 4</cite>, end <he>לובש מקורעים וזוסטא</he> (corr. acc.) puts on ragged garments and an apron.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 1:7:2">Y. Meg. I, 71ᵇ</cite> top <he>ההן זוסטה וכ׳</he> (corr. acc.) an apron whose meshes are wide &c.; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nedarim 4:1:2">Y. Ned. IV, beg. 38ᶜ</cite> <he>אהן זוסטה</he> (corr. acc.).
